N1-028.meaning: coupled with ~; with ~ also contributing (acting together with other causes to bring about a result)

N1-030.meaning: to originate in ~; to be triggered by ~ (a small trigger sparking a major subsequent incident or dispute)
N1-030.formation: Noun + に端を発する（に端を発して）
N1-030.example: 些細な誤解に端を発した争いが、大きな事件へと発展した。（A dispute that originated in a trivial misunderstanding developed into a major incident.）

N1-031.meaning: to be caused by ~; to be attributable to ~ (objectively pointing out the root cause of an accident or problem)
N1-031.formation: Noun + に起因する（に起因して）
N1-031.example: この事故は、作業員の不注意に起因するものと見られている。（This accident is believed to have been caused by a worker's carelessness.）

N1-033.meaning: apparently because ~; it seems that ~ (inferring the underlying reason from what one observes before one's eyes)

N1-033.example: よほど嬉しかったとみえて、彼は一日中ニコニコしている。（Apparently because he was extremely happy, he has been smiling all day.）

N1-034.meaning: to end up in the regrettable state of ~ (lamenting that a situation has steadily worsened to a hopeless outcome)

N1-037.meaning: together with the whole ~; involving the entire ~ (e.g., 家族ぐるみ, 会社ぐるみ, 町ぐるみ)
N1-037.example: 彼とは家族ぐるみで付き合っている。（Our whole families socialize together.）

N1-038.meaning: full of ~; a feast of all kinds of ~ (often used for food or hospitality, e.g., カニづくし, ごちそうづくし)
N1-038.example: 北海道旅行で、カニづくしの料理を堪能した。（On my trip to Hokkaido, I thoroughly enjoyed a full-course crab feast.）

N1-045.meaning: once ~ happens, it's all over (indicating that if the first clause occurs, all previous efforts come to nothing)
N1-045.formation: Verb (ba-form / ta-form + ら) + それまでだ
N1-045.example: どんなに素晴らしい計画でも、実行しなければそれまでだ。（No matter how wonderful a plan may be, if you don't carry it out, that's the end of it.）

N1-049.meaning: unique to ~; only possible with ~ (highly praising a unique strength of something)
N1-049.formation: Noun + ならでは（の + Noun / だ）
N1-049.example: 京都ならではの伝統的な料理を味わう。（Savor traditional cuisine that can only be found in Kyoto.）

N1-051.meaning: if it were ~ that might be another story, but ~ (in reality the second clause holds true, so it is out of the question)

N1-051.example: 10年前ならいざ知らず、今の時代にそんなやり方は通用しない。（Ten years ago might have been another story, but in this day and age, that kind of approach won't work.）

N1-057.meaning: if not ~; unless ~ (classical hypothetical negative form, mostly used in proverbs such as 虎穴に入らずんば虎子を得ず)
N1-057.formation: Verb (nai-stem) + ずんば (note: する → せずんば)
N1-057.example: 虎穴に入らずんば虎子を得ず。（Nothing ventured, nothing gained.）

N1-059.meaning: speaking of the degree of ~, it was truly ~ (followed by an extreme description to emphasize how extraordinary it was)
N1-059.example: あの時の怖さといったら、今でも忘れられないほどだ。（Speaking of how terrifying it was at that time, I still cannot forget it even now.）

N1-060.meaning: (1) even for ~, ~; (2) even if we look at it from the standpoint of ~, ~
N1-060.formation: Plain form (na-adjective / Noun without だ) + にしたところで（にしたって）

N1-061.meaning: even though ~; even ~ (literary and formal expression)
N1-061.formation: Plain form (na-adjective / Noun + である or without だ) + といえども
N1-061.example: いかにベテランの医師といえども、すべての病気を治せるわけではない。（No matter how veteran a doctor may be, they cannot cure every illness.）

N1-065.formation: Verb (volitional form) (or i-adjective かろう / na-adjective だろう) + と（も）／が
N1-065.example: 周囲に何を言われようと、自分の信念は曲げない。（No matter what the people around me say, I will not bend my convictions.）

N1-071.meaning: while remaining in the state of ~; from birth ~ (e.g., 生まれながらにして, 涙ながらに, 居ながらにして)
N1-071.formation: Verb (masu-stem) / Noun + ながらに（して）
N1-071.example: インターネットのおかげで、家に居ながらにして世界中のニュースがわかる。（Thanks to the Internet, we can learn about news from all over the world without leaving home.）

N1-075.meaning: in exchange for ~; at the cost of ~ (sacrificing something important in order to obtain something else)
N1-075.pattern: 〜とひきかえに（と引き換えに / in exchange for）
N1-075.example: 彼は莫大な財産とひきかえに、健康と家族を失ってしまった。（In exchange for vast wealth, he lost his health and his family.）

N1-077.meaning: ignoring ~; paying no heed to ~ (disregarding the worries or opposition of those around one)
N1-077.example: 住民の反対運動をよそに、ダムの建設工事は強行された。（Paying no heed to the residents' protest movement, the dam construction was forced through.）

N1-079.meaning: not to mention ~, ~ is even more so (while the first item goes without saying, the second item is also or even more important)
N1-079.formation: Noun + もさることながら
N1-079.example: 結果もさることながら、そこに至るまでの努力の過程が大切だ。（While the result is of course important, the process of effort leading up to it is what truly matters.）

N1-081.meaning: even just (imagining / dreaming of) ~ (emphasizing that the mere thought causes fear, or that one never even dreamed of it)
N1-081.formation: Verb (dictionary form: 想像する, 考える, 思う) / Noun (夢, 想像) + だに
N1-081.example: あんな恐ろしい事故は、思い出すだに身の毛がよだつ。（Just recalling such a dreadful accident makes my hair stand on end.）

N1-082.meaning: even ~ (citing an extreme example to imply that ordinary cases are all the more so; more literary than 「さえ」)
N1-082.example: その問題は難しすぎて、専門家ですら解けなかった。（That problem was so difficult that even experts could not solve it.）

N1-083.meaning: not even a single ~ (emphatic negation with a minimal unit)
N1-083.formation: Smallest unit counter (1秒, 1円, 1歩, 1人, etc.) + たりとも + negative
N1-083.example: 試験中は、1秒たりとも無駄にはできない。（During the exam, you cannot waste even a single second.）

N1-084.example: 彼は海外旅行はおろか、飛行機に乗ったことさえない。（Let alone traveling abroad, he hasn't even been on an airplane.）

N1-091.meaning: both A and B alike; everywhere from A to B (indicating a state covers everything, where A and B are usually body parts, times, or places)
N1-091.formation: Noun A + といわず + Noun B + といわず
N1-091.example: 子供は顔といわず手といわず、体中泥だらけにして帰ってきた。（The child came home covered in mud all over, face, hands, and all.）

N1-095.meaning: whether A or B (giving two feasible options and asking the other person to choose either one)
N1-095.example: 電話をかけるなりメールを送るなりして、早く彼に知らせてください。（Whether by making a phone call or sending an email, please let him know quickly.）

N1-096.meaning: saying things like ~ and ~ (mostly used to list someone's complaints, excuses, or dissatisfaction)
N1-096.example: 彼は頭が痛いだの熱があるだのと言って、仕事をサボろうとする。（He keeps saying things like he has a headache or he has a fever, trying to slack off from work.）

N1-097.meaning: what with ~ and ~ (describing a mix of emotions, or being hectically busy with many things at once)
N1-097.formation: Verb (dictionary form) / i-adjective / Noun + やら
N1-097.example: 合格の知らせを聞いて、嬉しいやらホッとするやらで涙が出た。（Hearing the news of my passing, what with feeling happy and feeling relieved, tears came to my eyes.）

N1-099.meaning: should I call it ~ or ~ (searching for the most fitting words to describe something)
N1-099.formation: Plain form (na-adjective / Noun without だ) + というか
N1-099.example: 彼の性格は、素直というか単純というか、とにかくわかりやすい。（His personality—should I call it honest or simple—in any case, he is easy to understand.）

N1-100.meaning: to be limited to ~; to remain at the level of ~ (failing to reach a higher stage, or keeping an impact within a small scope)
N1-100.formation: Verb (dictionary form) / Noun + にとどまる
N1-100.pattern: 〜にとどまる（に止まる / to be limited to）
N1-100.example: 今回の地震による被害は、幸いにも軽微なものにとどまった。（Fortunately, the damage caused by this earthquake remained minor.）

N1-101.meaning: in accordance with ~; following ~ (strictly observing established laws, traditions, or etiquette)
N1-101.formation: Noun (伝統, 規則, 法, 慣例) + に則って（に則った + Noun）

N1-102.meaning: in light of ~; by comparing with ~ (evaluating a current situation against a certain standard)
N1-102.formation: Noun (法, 規則, 良心, 事実) + に照らして
N1-102.example: 法律に照らして、彼の行為が正当かどうかを判断する。（We will judge whether his actions are justifiable in light of the law.）

N1-121.meaning: extremely ~; ~ to the utmost degree (mostly used for negative criticism)
N1-121.formation: i-adjective / na-adjective (without だ) / Noun + 極まりない（極まる）
N1-121.example: 飲酒運転など、危険極まりない行為だ。（Drunk driving and the like is an extremely dangerous act.）

N1-122.meaning: the height of ~; the utmost ~ (literary set phrase expressing an extreme degree, e.g., 痛恨の極み, 感激の極み, 贅沢の極み)
N1-122.example: 私の不注意でこのような事態を招き、痛恨の極みです。（It is a matter of the utmost regret that my carelessness caused such a situation.）

N1-123.meaning: extremely ~; the height of ~ (used for humility and gratitude in letters or speeches, e.g., 光栄の至り, 赤面の至り, 恐縮の至り)

N1-129.formation: Noun / Plain form + から + にほかならない

N1-140.meaning: (1) there is no need to ~ (with a verb); (2) to be no match for ~ / cannot compare to ~ (with a noun)
N1-140.formation: (1) Verb (dictionary form) + にはおよばない; (2) Noun + にはおよばない
N1-140.pattern: 〜にはおよばない（には及ばない / no need to; no match for）
N1-140.example: 電話で済む用件ですから、わざわざお越しいただくにはおよびません。（Since this matter can be settled over the phone, there is no need for you to trouble yourself to come all the way here.）

N1-141.meaning: should ~ / must not ~; ~ is prohibited (classical command and prohibition, commonly seen on signs, maxims, or notices)
N1-141.formation: Verb (dictionary form) + べし（べからず） (note: する → すべし／すべからず)

N1-142.meaning: in order to ~ (formal literary expression of purpose, where both clauses share the same subject)
N1-142.formation: Verb (dictionary form) + べく (note: する → すべく／するべく)
N1-142.example: 真相を明らかにすべく、調査委員会が設置された。（An investigative committee was established in order to uncover the truth.）

N1-144.meaning: unbecoming of ~; unforgivable ~ (for someone in a certain position; classical adnominal negative conjecture/prohibition)

N1-144.example: 暴力は教育者にあるまじき行為だ。（Violence is an act unbecoming of an educator.）

N1-146.meaning: that someone of the status or stature of ~ should do ~ (expressing shock, disappointment, or criticism)

N1-147.meaning: there is no need to ~; not worth ~; nothing to make a fuss about
N1-147.formation: Verb (dictionary form) / Noun (surprise, praise, criticism) + にはあたらない
N1-147.pattern: 〜にはあたらない（には当たらない / not worth）

N1-148.meaning: there is no need to ~; it goes without ~ (commonly used with verbs such as 「言う、調べる、説明する」)

N1-149.meaning: cannot help but make one ~; bound to ~

N1-158.meaning: in order to ~ (classical expression of purpose, emphasizing doing whatever it takes to achieve a strong goal)

N1-160.meaning: cannot get away without ~; must ~ to settle the matter (based on social norms or common sense)

N1-161.meaning: (1) like ~ / as if ~ (simile); (2) the likes of ~ / someone like ~ (expressing disdain or humility, e.g., 私ごときが)

N1-162.meaning: almost ~; as if about to ~ (describing an action or emotion reaching the brink)

N1-169.meaning: there are signs of ~; one gets the impression that ~ (inferring some hidden circumstance from observation)

N1-171.example: 彼女は小学生なのに、どこか大人びたところがある。（Although she is still an elementary school student, there is something grown-up about her.）

N1-172.meaning: to put on airs of ~; to pretend to be ~ (carries a critical tone, e.g., 上品ぶる, 偉ぶる, 知ったかぶる)
N1-172.formation: Noun / i-adjective (stem without い) / na-adjective (stem without な) + ぶる（ぶった + Noun）

N1-176.meaning: to make something sound like ~ on purpose; to adopt the tone of ~ (e.g., 冗談めかす = to say in a joking tone)

N1-179.meaning: neither clearly A nor B; hard to tell whether it is A or B

N1-186.meaning: worthy of ~; able to withstand ~ (indicating high quality, as opposed to the negative form meaning 'unbearable to ~')

N1-187.meaning: at most around ~; no more than ~ (objectively estimating the upper limit of something)

N1-190.meaning: there is nothing better than ~; it is best to ~ (formal literary expression, equivalent to 「〜に越したことはない」)

N1-191.meaning: under the pretext of ~; using ~ as an excuse (using a legitimate matter as an excuse to do what one privately wants)

N1-192.meaning: taking advantage of ~ (to push one's luck or act selfishly; negative evaluation)

N1-193.meaning: to be absorbed in ~; to be preoccupied with ~ (to the point of neglecting other things one should do)

N1-194.meaning: it is not altogether impossible to ~; it's not that I couldn't ~ (indirectly expressing that there is a slight possibility if conditions allow)

N1-195.meaning: if one starts ~, there is no end to it (commonly used with 「言う、挙げる、欲を言えば」, etc.)

N1-196.meaning: so ~ that I cannot stand it; unbearably ~

N1-197.meaning: there is a limit to ~; going too far with ~ (strongly criticizing someone's words or actions as exceeding tolerable limits)

N2-001.meaning: prior to ~; ahead of ~ (used for preparations made before an important event, ceremony, or project begins)

N2-004.meaning: as soon as ~; immediately upon ~ (indicating that once the first condition is met, the next action will be taken right away; not used with past tense in the main clause)

N2-005.meaning: ever since ~ (emphasizing that after a certain turning point, a thorough and lasting change occurred)

N3-015.example: 年をとるとともに、体力が落ちてきた。（As I grow older, my physical strength has declined.）

N3-016.meaning: 1. due to ~ (cause); 2. by means of ~ (method); 3. depending on ~; 4. by ~ (passive agent)
N3-016.formation: Noun + によって／による + Noun
N3-016.example: 台風によって、大きな被害が出た。（Due to the typhoon, extensive damage occurred.）

N3-018.meaning: because of excessive ~; out of too much ~ (leading to an extreme or undesirable result)
N3-018.formation: Verb (dictionary form / ta-form) / na-adjective + な / Noun + の + あまり
N3-018.example: 緊張のあまり、言うべきことを忘れてしまった。（Out of extreme nervousness, I completely forgot what I was supposed to say.）

N3-019.meaning: because ~ (used to excuse one's own mistake or explain an unavoidable personal reason)
N3-019.formation: Plain form (na-adjective + な / Noun + な) + ものだから
N3-019.example: 道が混んでいたものですから、遅れてすみません。（Because the roads were congested, I'm sorry I'm late.）

N3-020.meaning: precisely because ~, all the more ~ (the result naturally matches and is intensified by the preceding reason)
N3-020.formation: Plain form (na-adjective + な / Noun + な) + だけに
N3-020.example: 期待していただけに、がっかりした。（Precisely because I had high hopes, I was all the more disappointed.）

N3-021.meaning: simply because ~, (it led to the bad result that) ~ (negative outcome accompanied by regret)
N3-021.formation: Plain form (na-adjective + な / Noun + である) + ばかりに
N3-021.example: 嘘をついたばかりに、信用を失ってしまった。（Simply because I told a lie, I lost their trust.）

N3-022.meaning: now that ~; since ~, (must / definitely) ~ (followed by obligation, determination, or deduction)
N3-022.formation: Plain form (na-adjective / Noun + だ / である) + からには
N3-022.example: 試合に出るからには、絶対に勝ちたい。（Since I'm entering the match, I definitely want to win.）

N3-023.meaning: now that ~; since ~ (slightly more formal than 「からには」, emphasizing responsibility and conditions)
N3-023.formation: Plain form (na-adjective / Noun + である) + 以上（は）
N3-023.example: 約束した以上は、守らなければならない。（Once you have made a promise, you must keep it.）

N3-024.meaning: now that things have come to ~, there is no choice but to ~ (expressing firm resolve or readiness)
N3-024.example: こうなったうえは、やるしかない。（Now that things have come to this, we just have to do it.）

N3-025.meaning: just because ~, it does not necessarily mean ~ (followed by a negative, refuting a one-sided causal inference)
N3-025.formation: Plain form + からといって
N3-025.example: 日本に住んでいるからといって、日本語が上手になるとは限らない。（Just because you live in Japan doesn't necessarily mean your Japanese will get better.）

N3-026.meaning: due to ~; because of ~ (often used on store signs and formal notices)
N3-026.example: 工事中につき、立ち入り禁止。（No entry due to construction.）

N3-027.meaning: thanks to ~; owing to ~ (expresses gratitude or a positive result)
N3-027.formation: Plain form (na-adjective + な / Noun + の) + おかげで
N3-027.example: 毎日運動したおかげで、健康になった。（Thanks to exercising every day, I have become healthy.）

N3-028.meaning: because of ~; due to ~ (negative cause); 「〜せいか」 means "perhaps because of ~"
N3-028.formation: Plain form (na-adjective + な / Noun + の) + せいで (せいか)
N3-028.example: 季節の変わり目のせいか、風邪をひいている人が多い。（Perhaps because of the change of seasons, many people have caught a cold.）

N3-029.meaning: precisely because it is (someone), surely ~ (making a conjecture based on what one knows about that person's usual personality)
N3-029.formation: Noun (usually a person's name) + のことだから
N3-029.example: 真面目な彼女のことだから、きっと時間通りに来るでしょう。（Knowing how serious she is, she will surely come on time.）

N3-030.meaning: the reason why ~ is because ~ (states a conclusion first, then uses this pattern to add the reason)
N3-030.formation: なぜなら + Plain form (na-adjective / Noun + だ) + からだ
N3-030.example: 今日は早く帰る。なぜなら、子供の誕生日だからだ。（I'm going home early today. That's because it's my child's birthday.）

N3-032.meaning: although ~; even though ~ (acknowledges the preceding fact, but the following result does not go as hoped)
N3-032.formation: Plain form (na-adjective + な / Noun + である) + ものの
N3-032.example: 車を買ったものの、めったに乗らない。（Although I bought a car, I rarely drive it.）

N3-033.meaning: even though one says ~, actually it's only ~ (qualifies a statement to correct an exaggerated impression)
N3-033.example: 料理ができるといっても、簡単なものしか作れません。（Even though I say I can cook, I can only make simple things.）

N3-034.meaning: even though ~; despite ~ (carries a strong tone of blame, dissatisfaction, or contempt; used only for others)
N3-034.formation: Plain form (na-adjective + な / Noun + の) + くせに
N3-034.example: 彼は何も知らないくせに、何でも知っているような顔をする。（Even though he knows nothing, he acts as if he knows everything.）

N3-035.meaning: considering ~; for ~ (disproportionate to the usual standard, with an unexpected result)
N3-035.formation: Plain form (na-adjective + な / Noun + の) + わりに（は）
N3-035.example: このレストランは値段が高いわりには、あまり美味しくない。（Considering its high prices, this restaurant isn't very delicious.）

N3-036.meaning: for ~; considering ~ (the actual fact does not match expectations for that status or standard)
N3-036.formation: Plain form (na-adjective / Noun without だ) + にしては
N3-036.example: 彼は半年勉強したにしては、日本語が上手だ。（For someone who has studied for only half a year, his Japanese is good.）

N3-037.formation: Verb (masu-stem) / i-adjective / na-adjective / Noun + ながらも
N3-037.example: 狭いながらも、楽しい我が家だ。（Though cramped, it is our happy home.）

N3-039.meaning: even if one did ~ (it would be useless / would not bring a good result)
N3-039.example: 今から急いだところで、終電には間に合わない。（Even if I hurry now, I won't make the last train.）

N3-040.formation: Plain form (na-adjective / Noun without だ) + としても (にしても / にしろ / にせよ)
N3-040.example: 忙しかったにしても、連絡ぐらいできたはずだ。（Even if you were busy, you should have at least been able to contact me.）

N3-041.meaning: on the one hand ~, but on the other hand ~ (contrasting two opposite aspects of the same thing)
N3-041.formation: Plain form (na-adjective + な・である / Noun + である) + 反面
N3-041.example: 都会の生活は便利な反面、ストレスも多い。（City life is convenient on the one hand, but stressful on the other.）

N3-042.meaning: on the one hand ~, while at the same time ~ (juxtaposing two simultaneous or opposite trends)
N3-042.formation: Plain form (na-adjective + な・である / Noun + の・である) + 一方で
N3-042.example: 子どもが減る一方で、お年寄りが増えている。（While the number of children is decreasing, the number of elderly people is increasing.）

N3-043.meaning: in exchange for ~; while ~, on the other hand ~ (expresses mutual compensation of pros and cons or a trade-off)
N3-043.formation: Plain form (na-adjective + な) + かわりに
N3-043.example: この部屋は家賃が安い代わりに、駅から遠い。（While this room has cheap rent, it is far from the station.）

N3-044.meaning: in contrast to A, B is ~ (drawing a clear contrast between two things)
N3-044.formation: Plain form (na-adjective + な・である / Noun + なの・である) + のに対して
N3-044.example: 兄が活発なのに対して、弟はおとなしい。（In contrast to the outgoing older brother, the younger brother is quiet.）

N3-045.meaning: far from ~; let alone ~; not to mention ~ (far exceeding expectations or the complete opposite)
N3-045.formation: Plain form (na-adjective + な / Noun) + どころか
N3-045.example: 独身どころか、もう子供が3人もいるよ。（Far from being single, he already has three children!）

N3-046.formation: Plain form + としたら (とすれば / とすると)
N3-046.example: 100万円もらえるとしたら、何に使いますか。（If you were given one million yen, what would you use it for?）

N3-047.meaning: I wish I had ~; should have ~ (expresses regret over something not done or done wrongly in the past)
N3-047.formation: Verb (ba-form / ta-form + ら) + よかった
N3-047.example: もっと早く起きればよかった。（I wish I had woken up earlier.）

N3-048.meaning: if only ~; as long as ~ (indicates the sole minimum necessary condition)
N3-048.formation: Noun + さえ + Verb (ba-form) / i-adjective (ければ) / na-adjective (なら) | Verb (masu-stem) + さえすれば
N3-048.example: あなたさえそばにいてくれれば、他に何もいらない。（As long as you are by my side, I don't need anything else.）

N3-049.meaning: unless ~, cannot ~ (emphasizes that the preceding clause is a necessary prerequisite)
N3-049.formation: Verb (nai-form) / i-adjective (くない) / na-adjective・Noun + でない + ことには〜ない
N3-049.example: やってみないことには、できるかどうかわからない。（Unless you try doing it, you won't know whether you can do it or not.）

N3-050.meaning: (1) as long as ~ (continuation of a state); (2) to the extent of ~ (e.g., 私の知る限り = as far as I know)
N3-050.formation: Verb (dictionary form / て-いる / nai-form) / i-adjective / na-adjective + な / Noun + の + 限り
N3-050.example: 力のある限り、頑張ります。（As long as I have strength, I will do my best.）

N3-051.meaning: (1) of all times/days (something unlucky happens right when ~); (2) (someone) in particular would never ~ (expresses strong trust)
N3-051.example: 傘を持っていない日に限って、雨が降る。（Of all days, it rains on the day I don't have an umbrella.）

N3-052.meaning: not limited to ~ (applies to other areas as well)
N3-052.example: このアニメは子供に限らず、大人にも人気がある。（This anime is popular not only with children, but also with adults.）

N3-053.meaning: limited to ~ only (often used in commercial promotions and notices of eligibility)
N3-053.example: 女性のお客様に限り、デザートをサービスいたします。（For female customers only, we offer a complimentary dessert.）

N3-054.formation: Plain form (na-adjective + な / Noun) + だけでなく (ばかりでなく)
N3-054.example: 彼は英語だけでなく、中国語も話せる。（He can speak not only English, but also Chinese.）

N3-055.meaning: not only ~, but even ~ (stronger in tone than 「ばかりでなく」, often carrying a sense of surprise)
N3-055.formation: Plain form (na-adjective + な / Noun) + ばかりか
N3-055.example: 彼は漢字が読めないばかりか、ひらがなもよく間違える。（Not only can he not read kanji, he even frequently makes mistakes with hiragana.）

N3-056.formation: Noun + はもちろん (はもとより)
N3-056.example: 北海道は冬はもちろん、夏も観光地として人気がある。（Hokkaido is popular as a tourist destination in summer as well, not to mention winter.）

N3-058.meaning: rather than ~, I would prefer to ~ (expresses strong aversion to the first option)
N3-058.example: あんな人に頼むくらいなら、一人でやったほうがいい。（Rather than ask someone like that for help, it would be better to do it alone.）

N3-059.meaning: even if one has to resort to extreme measures like ~, one will ~
N3-059.example: 借金してでも、留学したい。（I want to study abroad even if I have to borrow money to do it.）

N3-060.meaning: without ~ (doing something without ~, or being unable to ~ without ~)
N3-060.formation: Noun / Verb (dictionary form) + こと + なしに (なしで)
N3-060.example: 辞書なしでは、この小説は読めない。（Without a dictionary, I cannot read this novel.）

N3-063.meaning: regarding ~; related to ~ (formal written equivalent of 「〜について」, with a broader scope)
N3-063.formation: Noun + に関して (に関する + Noun)
N3-063.example: この事件に関して、何か知っていることはありますか。（Do you know anything regarding this incident?）

N3-064.meaning: to ~; for ~; from the standpoint of ~ (followed by an evaluation or feeling)
N3-064.example: 私にとって、家族が一番大切だ。（To me, family is the most important thing.）

N3-065.meaning: as ~; in the capacity of ~ (qualification, position, or status)
N3-065.example: 彼は国費留学生として日本へ来た。（He came to Japan as a government-sponsored international student.）

N3-066.meaning: in ~; at ~; on ~ (place, time, field, or situation; formal written equivalent of 「で／に」)
N3-066.formation: Noun + において (における + Noun)
N3-066.example: 現代社会において、インターネットは欠かせない。（In modern society, the internet is indispensable.）

N3-067.meaning: when it comes to ~; in terms of ~ (followed by a positive assessment such as being unsurpassed or skilled)
N3-067.example: 走る速さにかけては、クラスで彼が一番だ。（When it comes to running speed, he is number one in the class.）

N3-068.meaning: (1) along ~ (geographical route); (2) in accordance with ~; following ~ (policy, plan, or rule)
N3-068.formation: Noun + に沿って (に沿った + Noun)
N3-068.example: マニュアルに沿って作業を進めてください。（Please proceed with the work in accordance with the manual.）

N3-070.meaning: concerning ~; over ~ (indicates multiple parties arguing, discussing, or competing over an issue)
N3-070.formation: Noun + をめぐって (をめぐる + Noun)
N3-070.example: 新しい法律をめぐって、議論が続いている。（Debate continues over the new law.）

N3-072.meaning: as ~; in proportion to ~ (as one thing changes, another changes in proportion)
N3-072.formation: Verb (dictionary form) / Noun + につれて (にしたがって)
N3-072.example: 台風が近づくにつれて、風が強くなってきた。（As the typhoon approached, the wind grew stronger.）

N3-073.meaning: along with ~; accompanying ~; as ~ (often used for large-scale or social changes)
N3-073.formation: Verb (dictionary form) / Noun + に伴って (に伴う + Noun)
N3-073.example: 人口の増加に伴って、住宅問題が深刻になっている。（Along with population growth, the housing problem is becoming more serious.）

N3-074.formation: Noun + に比べて (と比較して)
N3-074.example: 兄に比べて、弟は背が高い。（Compared to his older brother, the younger brother is tall.）

N3-075.meaning: in addition to ~ (adding something good on top of good, or bad on top of bad)
N3-075.example: 風が強いのに加えて、雨も激しく降ってきた。（In addition to the strong wind, it also started raining heavily.）

N3-076.example: この店は若い女性を中心に人気がある。（This shop is popular mainly among young women.）

N3-077.meaning: taking ~ as an opportunity; prompted by ~ (serving as the starting point for a change)
N3-077.formation: Noun + をきっかけに (を機に)
N3-077.example: 病気をきっかけに、お酒をやめた。（Prompted by my illness, I quit drinking alcohol.）

N3-078.meaning: regardless of ~; irrespective of ~ (not restricted by conditions such as age, gender, or experience)
N3-078.example: この仕事は経験を問わず、誰でも応募できます。（Anyone can apply for this job, regardless of experience.）

N3-079.meaning: (1) -ish; looking like ~; having the feel of ~; (2) prone to ~; easily ~ (e.g., 忘れっぽい, 怒りっぽい)
N3-079.example: 彼女は大人っぽい服を着ている。（She is wearing mature-looking clothes.）

N3-081.meaning: slightly ~; showing a slight tendency toward ~ (often used for mild physical indisposition or slight mental states)
N3-081.pattern: 〜ぎみだ（気味だ: a touch of ~ / slightly ~）
N3-081.example: 最近、少し疲れぎみだ。（Lately, I have been feeling a bit tired.）

N3-082.meaning: full of ~; covered with ~ (used for negative things such as mistakes, trash, scars, or mud)
N3-082.example: この作文は間違いだらけだ。（This essay is full of mistakes.）

N3-083.meaning: covered in ~; smeared with ~ (used for things that stick to a surface, such as sweat, mud, blood, or dust)
N3-083.example: 子供たちは泥まみれになって遊んでいる。（The children are playing, covered in mud.）

N3-084.meaning: entirely ~; nothing but ~ (e.g., 黒ずくめ = dressed all in black; いいことずくめ = full of good things)
N3-084.example: 今日はいいことずくめの1日だった。（Today was a day full of nothing but good things.）

N3-085.meaning: as if ~; just as though ~ (used for vivid figurative comparisons when something is not actually the case)
N3-085.formation: Plain form (na-adjective / Noun without だ or + である) + かのようだ
N3-085.example: 彼はまるで自分で見たかのように話す。（He speaks just as if he had seen it himself.）

N3-088.meaning: must be ~; no doubt that ~; surely ~ (a subjective deduction made with strong confidence)
N3-088.formation: Plain form (na-adjective / Noun without だ) + に違いない
N3-088.example: 犯人はあの男に違いない。（The culprit must be that man.）

N3-090.meaning: no way ~; impossible to ~ (strongly denies the possibility of something happening in casual speech)
N3-090.example: こんな難しい問題、私にできっこないよ。（There's no way I can solve such a difficult problem.）

N3-091.meaning: not necessarily ~; not always ~ (indicates that exceptions exist; partial negation)
N3-091.formation: Plain form (na-adjective / Noun without だ) + とは限らない
N3-091.example: 高いものがいつもいいとは限らない。（Expensive things are not necessarily always good.）

N3-092.meaning: it is not impossible that ~; might well ~ (double negative warning that something may happen)
N3-092.formation: Verb (nai-form) / i-adjective (くない) / na-adjective・Noun + でない + とも限らない
N3-092.example: 途中で雨が降らないとも限らないから、傘を持っていこう。（It might rain on the way, so let's take an umbrella.）

N3-093.meaning: rather than A, it is more like B (indicates that the latter description is more fitting)
N3-093.formation: Plain form (na-adjective / Noun without だ) + というより
N3-093.example: 彼は友達というより、家族のような存在だ。（He is more like family than a friend.）

N3-094.meaning: to the extent that ~; so ~ that ~ (uses an exaggerated comparison to describe an extreme degree)
N3-094.formation: Plain form (na-adjective + な / Noun) + くらい (ほど)
N3-094.pattern: 〜くらい／〜ぐらい／〜ほど（emphasis on degree）
N3-094.example: お腹が痛くて、死ぬかと思うほど苦しかった。（My stomach hurt so badly that I thought I was going to die.）

N3-095.meaning: there is nothing as ~ as ~ (expresses the superlative by negating everything else)
N3-095.formation: Noun + ほど (くらい) + Adjective + Noun + はない
N3-095.example: 健康ほど大切なものはない。（There is nothing as important as health.）

N3-096.meaning: should ~ / should not ~ (advice or obligation based on morality, common sense, or responsibility)
N3-096.formation: Verb (dictionary form) + べきだ (*する → すべきだ / するべきだ)
N3-096.example: 約束は守るべきだ。（Promises should be kept.）

N3-097.meaning: (1) no wonder ~; (2) naturally ~; (3) in other words ~ (a conclusion derived logically)
N3-097.formation: Plain form (na-adjective + な / Noun + な・の) + わけだ
N3-097.example: エアコンが壊れているのか。どうりで暑いわけだ。（Is the air conditioner broken? No wonder it's so hot.）

N3-098.meaning: there is no way that ~; it is impossible that ~ (strong denial of possibility)
N3-098.formation: Plain form (na-adjective + な / Noun + の・である) + わけがない
N3-098.example: そんな高い車、買えるわけがない。（There is no way I can afford such an expensive car.）

N3-099.meaning: it is not the case that ~; it doesn't mean that ~ (used for polite or partial negation)
N3-099.formation: Plain form (na-adjective + な / Noun + な・の) + わけではない
N3-099.example: 甘いものが嫌いなわけではないが、今は食べたくない。（It's not that I dislike sweets, I just don't want to eat any right now.）

N3-100.meaning: cannot ~ (unable to do something due to social norms, one's position, or moral/psychological reasons)
N3-100.formation: Verb (dictionary form) + わけにはいかない
N3-100.example: 明日テストがあるから、今夜は寝るわけにはいかない。（I have a test tomorrow, so I cannot go to sleep tonight.）

N3-101.meaning: cannot help but ~; have no choice but to ~ (must do something out of duty or social obligation)
N3-101.formation: Verb (nai-form) + わけにはいかない
N3-101.example: 上司に誘われたら、行かないわけにはいかない。（If my boss invites me, I cannot refuse to go.）

N3-104.meaning: there is no need to ~ (reassuring or advising someone not to worry)
N3-104.example: まだ時間はあるから、急ぐことはないよ。（There's still time, so there's no need to hurry.）

N3-105.meaning: must be ~; bound to ~ (more colloquial and assertive/subjective than 「に違いない」)
N3-105.formation: Plain form (na-adjective / Noun without だ) + に決まっている
N3-105.example: そんなことをしたら、怒られるに決まっている。（If you do something like that, you're bound to get scolded.）

N3-107.meaning: this is what is truly called ~; really is ~ (defining the true nature of something, or expressing a natural sentiment)
N3-107.formation: Plain form (na-adjective / Noun without だ) + というものだ
N3-107.example: ピンチの時に助け合うのが、友達というものだ。（Helping each other in a pinch is what being friends is all about.）

N3-108.meaning: it is not simply a matter of ~ (refutes a one-sided view, emphasizing that the nature of the matter is not so simple)
N3-108.formation: Plain form + というものではない
N3-108.example: 謝れば済むというものではない。（It's not something that can be settled just by apologizing.）

N3-109.meaning: it is natural to ~ (common sense); one should ~ / should never ~ (moral admonition)
N3-109.formation: Verb (dictionary form / nai-form) / Adjective + ものだ (ものではない)
N3-109.pattern: 〜ものだ／〜ものではない（common sense / nature / admonition）
N3-109.example: お年寄りには親切にするものだ。（One should be kind to the elderly.）

N3-110.meaning: used to ~ (fondly recalling something done frequently in the past)
N3-110.example: 子供の頃、よくこの川で泳いだものだ。（When I was a child, I often used to swim in this river.）

N3-111.meaning: as if ~!; no way will I ~! (rhetorical question expressing strong denial or determination)
N3-111.formation: Plain form (na-adjective + な / Noun + な) + ものか (もんか)
N3-111.example: あんな失礼な店、二度と行くもんか。（As if I would ever go to such a rude shop again!）

N3-112.meaning: isn't it ~?; couldn't it be ~? (politely putting forward a conjecture or a differing opinion)
N3-112.formation: Plain form (na-adjective / Noun + な) + のではないか (んじゃない？)
N3-112.example: この計算、間違っているんじゃないですか。（Isn't this calculation wrong?）

N3-113.meaning: just starting to ~; about to ~; half-done / in the middle of ~

N4-091.meaning: 1. I heard that ~ (same as 「〜そうだ」); 2. what is called ~ / ~ means (same as 「〜というのは」)
N4-091.example: 来週テストがあるって本当？（Is it true that there's a test next week?）

N4-092.meaning: I wonder if ~ (asking oneself a question or making a gentle inquiry)
N4-092.formation: Plain form (Noun / na-adjective without だ) + かな
N4-092.example: 明日は晴れるかな。（I wonder if it will be sunny tomorrow.）

N4-093.example: 社長はもうお帰りになりました。（The company president has already gone home.）

N4-095.formation: お + Native Japanese verb (masu-stem) / ご + Sino-Japanese noun + ください
N4-095.pattern: お／ご＋動詞ます形＋ください（honorific request）
N4-095.example: どうぞお入りください。（Please come in.）

N4-097.meaning: (I) do ~ (for a superior / client) (humble expression lowering one's own action to show respect)
N4-097.formation: お + Native Japanese verb (masu-stem) / ご + Sino-Japanese noun + する（いたす）
N4-097.pattern: お／ご＋動詞ます形＋する／いたす（humble）
N4-097.example: お荷物をお持ちしましょうか。（Shall I carry your luggage for you?）

N4-099.formation: Noun / na-adjective + でございます
N4-099.example: こちらが会議室でございます。（This way is the conference room.）

N4-101.meaning: is it alright?; would it be convenient? (polite equivalent of 「いいですか」)
N4-101.example: お名前をお聞きしてもよろしいでしょうか。（May I ask your name?）

N4-102.meaning: could you please ~? (polite request commonly used in business and formal situations)
N4-102.formation: Verb (te-form) + いただけますか / くださいますか
N4-102.example: こちらにご記入いただけますか。（Could you please fill this in here?）

N4-103.meaning: be doing ~; have done ~ (honorific equivalent of 「〜ています」, e.g., お持ちです, お帰りです)
N4-103.pattern: お＋動詞ます形＋です（honorific state）
N4-103.example: ポイントカードはお持ちですか。（Do you have a point card?）

N4-104.meaning: shall I ~ for you? (proactively offering assistance to a client or superior)
N4-104.formation: お / ご + Verb (masu-stem) + いたしましょうか
N4-104.example: タクシーをお呼びいたしましょうか。（Shall I call a taxi for you?）

N4-105.meaning: by ~; before ~ (indicates a deadline by which an action is completed, unlike 「まで」 which indicates continuation)
N4-105.example: レポートは金曜日までに出してください。（Please hand in the report by Friday.）

N4-106.meaning: only ~; nothing but ~ (emphasizes a small quantity or uniqueness)
N4-106.formation: Noun / Quantifier + しか + Negative form
N4-106.example: 財布に1000円しかありません。（I only have 1,000 yen in my wallet.）

N4-108.meaning: ~ or something (putting forward a representative example as a suggestion)
N4-108.example: お茶でも飲みませんか。（Would you like to have some tea or something?）

N4-109.meaning: things like ~ and ~ (colloquial listing of examples, similar to 「〜や〜など」 and 「〜たり〜たり」)
N4-109.example: 休日は掃除とか洗濯とかをします。（On holidays I do things like cleaning and laundry.）

N4-111.example: 日本の歴史について調べています。（I am researching Japanese history.）

N4-114.meaning: in addition to ~; besides ~; other than ~
N4-114.formation: Noun + の / Verb (plain form) + ほかに
N4-114.example: 英語のほかに、フランス語も話せます。（Besides English, I can also speak French.）

N4-117.formation: Noun / Verb (dictionary form) + ほど + Negative form
N4-117.example: 今年は去年ほど寒くないです。（This year is not as cold as last year.）

N4-120.meaning: ~? (familiar question-ending particle used by men toward equals or juniors, limited to yes/no questions)
N4-120.formation: Plain form (Noun / na-adjective without だ) + かい
N4-120.example: もう宿題は終わったかい？（Have you finished your homework already?）

N5-002.meaning: N1 is not N2 (present negative of 「です」; 「じゃ」 is more colloquial, 「では」 is more formal)
N5-002.formation: Noun 1 + は + Noun 2 + じゃありません（ではありません）
N5-002.example: 田中さんは医者じゃありません。（Mr. Tanaka is not a doctor.）

N5-011.meaning: from A to B (indicates the starting point and endpoint in time or space; can be used separately)
N5-011.formation: Noun A (time / place) + から + Noun B + まで
N5-011.example: 銀行は9時から3時までです。（The bank is open from 9 o'clock to 3 o'clock.）

N5-026.meaning: about ~; approximately ~ (expresses an approximate amount or length of time)
N5-026.example: 家から駅まで15分ぐらいかかります。（It takes about 15 minutes from my house to the station.）

N5-027.meaning: around ~ (attached only to specific points in time; 「に」 is optional after it)
N5-027.example: 昨日、11時ごろ寝ました。（I went to bed around 11 o'clock yesterday.）

N5-028.meaning: only ~; just ~ (expresses limitation; can be followed by an affirmative predicate)
N5-028.example: 休みは日曜日だけです。（My only day off is Sunday.）

N5-029.formation: 誰も / 何も / どこ（へ）も / いつも + Verb (negative form)
N5-029.example: 昨日はどこへも行きませんでした。（I didn't go anywhere yesterday.）

N5-030.formation: 誰でも / 何でも / どこでも / いつでも + Affirmative form
N5-030.example: 何でも食べられます。（I can eat anything.）

N5-038.meaning: ~ each; ~ at a time (indicates equal distribution)
N5-038.example: 紙を1枚ずつ配ってください。（Please hand out one sheet of paper to each person.）

N5-046.meaning: although ~, ~; ~, but ~ (connects two contrasting evaluations, or introduces a remark as in 「すみませんが〜」)
N5-046.example: 日本の食べ物は美味しいですが、高いです。（Japanese food is delicious, but it is expensive.）

N5-049.meaning: how is ~?; how about ~? (「いかが」 is the polite equivalent of 「どう」, often used when offering tea or asking for an opinion)
N5-049.formation: Topic + は + どうですか（どうでしたか）
N5-049.example: 日本の生活はどうですか。（How is life in Japan?）

N5-051.meaning: like ~ / dislike ~ (the object of affection or dislike is marked with the particle 「が」)
N5-051.formation: Noun + が + 好きです（すきです） / 嫌いです（きらいです）
N5-051.example: 私は音楽が好きです。（I like music.）

N5-052.meaning: be good at ~ / be bad at ~ (「上手」 is usually used to praise others, while 「得意」 is preferred for oneself)
N5-052.formation: Noun + が + 上手です（じょうずです） / 下手です（へたです）
N5-052.example: 彼女は歌が上手です。（She is good at singing.）

N5-053.meaning: understand ~ / can do ~ (the object of ability or comprehension is marked with the particle 「が」)
N5-053.formation: Noun + が + わかります (understand) / できます (can do)
N5-053.example: 私は少し日本語がわかります。（I understand a little Japanese.）

N5-054.meaning: I want (something) (expresses the first person's desire, or asks about the second person's desire in questions)
N5-054.formation: Noun + が + ほしいです (negative: ほしくないです)
N5-054.example: 新しいパソコンがほしいです。（I want a new computer.）

N5-057.meaning: go / come / return to [place] to do [purpose] (marks the purpose of movement with the particle 「に」)
N5-057.formation: Place + へ + Verb (masu-stem) / Verbal noun + に + Motion verb
N5-057.example: デパートへ買い物に行きます。（I am going to the department store to go shopping.）

N5-058.formation: Used standalone (particles 「を」 and 「へ」 are often omitted after them)
N5-058.example: 喉が渇きましたから、何か飲みたいです。（Since I am thirsty, I want to drink something.）

N5-059.meaning: won't you ~ (with me)?; would you like to ~? (a polite way of inviting someone while respecting their wishes)
N5-059.example: 一緒に昼ご飯を食べませんか。（Would you like to eat lunch together?）

N5-060.meaning: let's ~! (proactively making a suggestion, or gladly accepting someone's 「〜ませんか」 invitation)
N5-060.example: 少し休みましょう。（Let's take a short break.）

N5-061.meaning: shall I ~ for you? (proactively offering help to someone)
N5-061.example: 荷物を持ちましょうか。（Shall I carry your luggage?）

N5-063.meaning: please do ~ (requesting, instructing, or recommending someone to do an action)
N5-063.example: ここに名前を書いてください。（Please write your name here.）

N5-069.meaning: after doing ~ (emphasizes that the second action takes place after the first action is completed)
N5-069.example: 手を洗ってから、ご飯を食べます。（After washing my hands, I eat my meal.）

N5-072.meaning: how to ~; the way of doing ~
N5-072.example: この漢字の読み方を教えてください。（Please tell me how to read this kanji.）

N5-073.meaning: while doing ~ (the same person performs two actions simultaneously, with the second clause being the main action)
N5-073.example: お茶を飲みながら話しましょう。（Let's talk while drinking tea.）

N5-076.example: 心配しないでください。（Please don't worry.）

N5-079.meaning: without doing ~ (doing the second action without doing the first action)
N5-079.example: 辞書を見ないでテストを受けます。（I take the test without looking at a dictionary.）

N5-081.meaning: before ~ (always preceded by the dictionary form of a verb regardless of whether the main clause is past or future)
N5-081.formation: Verb (dictionary form) / Noun + の / Time quantifier + 前に
N5-081.example: 寝る前に日記を書きます。（I write in my diary before going to bed.）

N5-088.example: 私はコーヒーにします。（I'll have coffee.）

N5-091.formation: Noun A + は + Noun B + より + Adjective + です
N5-091.pattern: A は B より〜です（comparing two things）
N5-091.example: 飛行機は新幹線より速いです。（Airplanes are faster than bullet trains.）

N5-092.meaning: between A and B, which is more ~? / ~ is more ~
N5-092.formation: A + と + B + と + どちらが + Adjective + ですか
N5-092.example: サッカーと野球とどちらが好きですか。―野球のほうが好きです。（Which do you like better, soccer or baseball? — I like baseball better.）

N5-093.meaning: among [group/category], what (where / who / when) is the most ~?
N5-093.formation: Noun (category / scope) + で + 何（どこ・だれ・いつ） + が一番 + Adjective + ですか
N5-093.pattern: ［範圍］で［疑問詞］が一番〜ですか（superlative）
N5-093.example: 果物で何が一番好きですか。―いちごが一番好きです。（Among fruits, what do you like the best? — I like strawberries the best.）

N5-094.formation: [Giver (I)] は [Receiver] に [Object] をあげます (to superiors: さしあげます)
N5-094.example: 私は母に花をあげました。（I gave flowers to my mother.）

N5-095.formation: [Receiver (I)] は [Giver] に（から） [Object] をもらいます (from superiors: いただきます)
N5-095.example: 私は友達にプレゼントをもらいました。（I received a present from my friend.）

N5-096.meaning: (someone) gives [something] to (me or someone in my in-group)
N5-096.formation: [Giver] は（私に） [Object] をくれます (from superiors: くださいます)
N5-096.pattern: くれます（others giving to me）
N5-096.example: 先生が本をくださいました。（The teacher gave me a book.）

N5-097.meaning: because ~, ~ (subjectively states a cause or reason)
N5-097.formation: Clause (polite or plain form) + から、 + Main clause (or: 〜からです)
N5-097.example: 時間がありませんから、タクシーで行きます。（Because I don't have time, I will go by taxi.）
